verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway documents plugin-based authentication (JWT, basic auth, OAuth2, ACLs) directly enforceable on upstream APIs, plus mTLS-related vault/secret management support, and the README explicitly demos adding auth to an API in minutes. missing for 10: no explicit first-party doc citation for API-key or mTLS plugin specifics, and no independent/hands-on verification of these auth plugins in production beyond vendor docs/README.
